ValidationRule.description: Ensures all mandatory fields on the Submission are filled before saving. Self-service sources (Website Applicant, Candidate Portal) are exempt, as those recruiter-only fields are filled in later.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Submission_Source__c, "Website Applicant"), ISPICKVAL(Submission_Source__c, "Candidate Portal") )), OR( ISBLANK(Job_Requirement__c), ISBLANK(Submitted_By__c), ISBLANK(Account_Manager__c), ISPICKVAL(Submission_Status__c, ''), ISBLANK(Internal_Submission_Date_Time__c), Candidate_Rate__c = NULL, ISBLANK(Candidate_Summary__c), ISBLANK(Unique_Submission_Key__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in all required fields: Job Requirement, Candidate, Submitted By, Account Manager, Submission Status, Internal Submission Date Time, Candidate Rate, Candidate Summary and Unique Submission Key.
